notes.title: Patch notes for 1.6.5.1
notes.notes:
Updated API level
 Fixed some bugs

notes.title: Update Notes for BlastFort 1.6.4.1
notes.notes: Added the ultimate achievement: Get a score of 100,000 in singleplayer in the Hell Scape map using only an Assault Rifle and Grenades, while not catching fire at all! (we're not even sure if that's possible)Fixed issues with multiplayer crashing for peers for no reasonAdded support for custom WebRTC WebSocket servers to ensure future compatibility (Officially Supported Signaling Server)Fixed an issue causing Forcefields/Grenades to not work correctly in multiplayer on touch devicesUpdated physics iterations for Forcefields/GrenadesFixed a bug causing the game to hang upon the games end due to repeated snapshotsFixed a bug causing the on screen keyboard to display the wrong selector over the space bar

notes.title: Update Notes for BlastFort 1.6.2.0
notes.notes:
Fixed a bug causing multiplayer to fail to load on C3e
Fixed a bug causing Knight's Shield DLC content to not activate correctly
Fixed a bug causing lag after a game ends in multiplayer
